from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import json,subprocess
root=Path('/home/moloch/semabi');rel=Path('docs/data/v4/transport/development/widget_key_revision_repair_v1')
rows=[]
for wt,name in [('runs/.w3_baseline_v4_worktree','root_focused_baseline_v2'),('runs/.w3_repair_worktree','root_focused_candidate_v2')]:
    p=root/wt/rel/name;job=json.loads((p/'job_v1/process.json').read_text())
    members=[]
    for line in subprocess.check_output(['ps','-e','-o','pid=,ppid=,pgid=,stat=,args='],text=True).splitlines():
        fields=line.split(None,4)
        if int(fields[2])==job['owned_process_group']:members.append(line.strip())
    record={'schema':'semabi.widget_key_revision.focused_host_termination.v1','created_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'runner_pid':job['runner_pid'],'child_pid':job['child_pid'],'runner_present':(Path('/proc')/str(job['runner_pid'])).exists(),'child_present':(Path('/proc')/str(job['child_pid'])).exists(),'child_process_group_members':members,'scope':'Actual post-exit host process sample, not a live environment measurement. Candidate completed directly in exec_command; baseline used its owned session.'}
    assert not record['runner_present'] and not record['child_present'] and not members
    with (p/'root_host_termination_v1.json').open('x') as out:json.dump(record,out,indent=2,sort_keys=True);out.write('\n')
    rows.append(record)
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
PY
